target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Val Verde is documented in the Amistad/Seminole Canyon regional flora; the species is primarily Chihuahuan/Trans-Pecos.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Fewer than three exact target-zone native counties locked.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not infer county presence from broad regional occurrence.

morphology.look_here_first: New Mexico dalea is a perennial dry-country prairie clover with pinnate leaves, downy foliage, and compact purple-violet flower spikes; mature calyx and leaflet characters are important for confirmation.
